name: WikiLeaks Podesta Cache
summary: DeLonge-Podesta correspondence revelada: McCasland, Apollo astronaut conversations, Roswell references
summary_en: DeLonge-Podesta correspondence revealed: McCasland, Apollo astronaut conversations, Roswell references

evidenceContribution.rationale: Correspondencia filtrada entre John Podesta (Counselor to Obama + Hillary Clinton campaign chairman) y Tom DeLonge (TTSA founder), Edgar Mitchell (astronaut Apollo 14), y otros, discutiendo en términos institucionales la realidad de UAP/Non-Human Intelligence y el manejo del disclosure. Es evidencia primaria de que conversaciones sobre divulgación UAP a nivel institucional alto estaban activas en 2016. Modest porque los emails establecen el discurso interno (acknowledgment del tema en nivel político alto) pero NO confirman existencia de programa específico ni naturaleza del fenómeno — la inferencia es desde el patrón comunicacional, no desde contenido decisional.
evidenceContribution.rationaleEn: Leaked correspondence between John Podesta (Counselor to Obama + Hillary Clinton campaign chairman) and Tom DeLonge (TTSA founder), Edgar Mitchell (Apollo 14 astronaut), and others, discussing in institutional terms the reality of UAP/Non-Human Intelligence and disclosure management. Primary evidence that high-level institutional conversations about UAP disclosure were active in 2016. Modest because the emails establish internal discourse (acknowledgment of the topic at high political level) but do NOT confirm existence of a specific program nor the phenomenon's nature — inference is from communicational pattern, not from decisional content.

whatHappened:
En octubre de 2016, WikiLeaks publicó el archivo masivo de emails del jefe de campaña presidencial demócrata John Podesta (Podesta Email Cache). Entre los 50,000+ documentos divulgados, varios intercambios revelaron correspondencia sustantiva entre Podesta y figuras del espacio UAP/divulgación: el músico y empresario Tom DeLonge (fundador de To The Stars Academy), el astronauta Edgar Mitchell (Apollo 14), el empresario Bigelow y referencias indirectas a figuras como McCasland.

Los emails de DeLonge a Podesta (2015-2016) describen estructura institucional del programa UAP estadounidense, identifican contactos específicos en USAF, DoD e Intelligence Community, mencionan objetivos de divulgación coordinada y discuten estrategia de comunicación. Podesta había sido públicamente vocal sobre el tema UAP — declaró en 2015 que su 'mayor frustración' del primer término Obama era 'el secreto sobre los UFOs'.

Los emails de Edgar Mitchell a Podesta (2015) mencionan reuniones planificadas sobre 'extraterrestrial disclosure' y refieren conversaciones con Pope Francis sobre tecnología 'zero-point energy'. La autenticidad del cache fue confirmada por verificación criptográfica DKIM (los servidores de Google firmaron los emails originalmente). El contenido es divulgación involuntaria pero autenticada de comunicaciones que documentan, independientemente de su contenido sustantivo, que figuras de máximo nivel político estadounidense (Podesta, jefe de gabinete Clinton y Obama) participaban activamente en discusiones operacionales sobre divulgación UAP.
whatHappened_en:
In October 2016, WikiLeaks published the massive email archive of Democratic presidential campaign chairman John Podesta (Podesta Email Cache). Among the 50,000+ disclosed documents, several exchanges revealed substantive correspondence between Podesta and figures from the UAP/disclosure space: the musician and entrepreneur Tom DeLonge (founder of To The Stars Academy), the astronaut Edgar Mitchell (Apollo 14), the entrepreneur Bigelow, and indirect references to figures such as McCasland.

DeLonge's emails to Podesta (2015-2016) describe the institutional structure of the U.S. UAP program, identify specific contacts in the USAF, DoD, and Intelligence Community, mention coordinated disclosure objectives, and discuss communication strategy. Podesta had been publicly vocal about the UAP topic — he declared in 2015 that his 'biggest frustration' of Obama's first term was 'the secrecy about UFOs'.

Edgar Mitchell's emails to Podesta (2015) mention planned meetings about 'extraterrestrial disclosure' and refer to conversations with Pope Francis about 'zero-point energy' technology. The cache's authenticity was confirmed by DKIM cryptographic verification (Google's servers had originally signed the emails). The content is an involuntary but authenticated disclosure of communications that document, regardless of their substantive content, that figures at the highest level of U.S. politics (Podesta, chief of staff to Clinton and Obama) were actively participating in operational discussions about UAP disclosure.
whyMatters: Único caso global con divulgación cryptographically auténtica de comunicaciones privadas entre figura política de máximo nivel (Podesta) y operadores activos del campo UAP (DeLonge, Mitchell). Independientemente de discusiones sobre contenido sustantivo, establece documentalmente la existencia de una red operacional de pre-divulgación que precedió por años a los eventos públicos de 2017-2026 (NYT Glowing Auras, AATIP, AARO, Grusch testimony).
whyMatters_en: The only global case with a cryptographically authentic disclosure of private communications between a top-level political figure (Podesta) and active operators of the UAP field (DeLonge, Mitchell). Regardless of discussions about substantive content, it documentarily establishes the existence of an operational pre-disclosure network that preceded by years the public events of 2017-2026 (NYT Glowing Auras, AATIP, AARO, Grusch testimony).
evidence: Emails DeLonge-Podesta autenticados por DKIM signature de Gmail
Verificación criptográfica de autenticidad por investigadores independientes
Coherencia narrativa con eventos institucionales posteriores (TTSA → AATIP → AARO)
evidence_en: DeLonge-Podesta emails authenticated by Gmail's DKIM signature
Cryptographic verification of authenticity by independent researchers
Narrative coherence with subsequent institutional events (TTSA → AATIP → AARO)
